To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Facebook has become a prevalent means of romantic relationship maintenance and communication, particularly for emerging adults, and that going Facebook official has unique meanings for users that are related to both social and interpersonal motives.

1) going Facebook official is a unique and common practice among emerging adults; 2) going Facebook official conveys commitment and intensity; 3) going Facebook official can be used as a tool to increase relationship satisfaction and decrease uncertainty; and 4) men and women differ in their perceptions of the meaning behind going Facebook official.
Facebook has become an important part of romantic relationship development, particularly in the context of going Facebook official.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which Facebook is changing the nature of romantic relationships, particularly the way in which Facebook users perceive and enact romantic relationships.
the role of technology in the development of romantic relationships.
understanding how emerging adults use technology in their romantic relationships and how this may influence their relationship development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of Facebook in romantic relationships has become a normative and accepted practice.

Facebook is a prevalent and important social tool in the development and maintenance of romantic relationships, and the ability to declare one's relationship status online is an important social cue that has the potential to influence relationship satisfaction.

the use of Facebook in the development of relationships is becoming more prevalent and the use of Facebook to declare one's relationship status is an increasingly important part of the relationship development process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Facebook is a prevalent and meaningful tool for emerging adults' romantic relationship development.
emerging adults are increasingly utilizing social media to communicate with romantic partners and are using Facebook as a tool to express commitment and intensity.
Facebook is an important tool in romantic relationship development, particularly in terms of commitment and intensity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Facebook can be used to facilitate relationship development and maintenance, and that the ability to “go Facebook official” is a powerful and prevalent tool in this process.
social networking sites are becoming more integrated into the development of romantic relationships, and this integration may have both positive and negative consequences.
the social affordances of Facebook have become an important part of how young adults manage their romantic relationships.
